phrase.en: Chinese AI powerhouses lack profit strategy
phrase.zh: 中国AI巨头缺乏盈利策略

phrase.en: China gives away models, struggles to monetize
phrase.zh: 中国开源模型，变现困难

gloss.en: Even China's best AI labs struggle to turn tech into money, echoing Silicon Valley's own doubts.
gloss.zh: 连中国顶尖AI实验室都难以将技术变现，与硅谷的疑虑遥相呼应。

why_now.en: You follow LLM and business models: today two sources converge on the same profit question from different sides of the Pacific.
why_now.zh: 你关注大语言模型与商业模式，今日跨洋两家媒体同时聚焦同一个盈利难题。

phrase.en: travel cancellations due to European wildfires
phrase.zh: 欧洲野火导致旅行取消

phrase.en: race to contain blazes before heatwave

gloss.en: France and Spain fight record blazes as heatwave returns, forcing evacuations and cancellations.
gloss.zh: 法国与西班牙奋力扑救创纪录山火，热浪来袭，民众疏散、行程取消。

why_now.en: You care about climate and data: the pyrocumulonimbus is a new visual phenomenon you can track.
why_now.zh: 你关注气候与数据：火积云是一种新的可视现象，值得追踪。

phrase.en: extends Senate leave, misses state picnic
phrase.zh: 延长参议院休假，错过州野餐

phrase.en: not medically cleared to resume role
phrase.zh: 未获医疗许可重返岗位

gloss.en: Senator Mitch McConnell remains in rehab, missing work and a state picnic, as doctors say he's not cleared.
gloss.zh: 参议员麦康奈尔持续康复，错过工作与州野餐，医生称其尚未获准出院。

why_now.en: You track political narratives: two sources give near-identical updates on a key figure's absence.
why_now.zh: 你关注政治叙事：两家媒体对关键人物缺席给出了几乎一致的更新。

phrase.zh: 微软发布AI网络安全工具

gloss.en: Microsoft launches AI cybersecurity tools and a dedicated model, betting safety will be a growth business.
gloss.zh: 微软推出AI网络安全工具及专用模型，押注安全将成为增长业务。

why_now.en: You follow embodied AI and LLM: today's AI security news directly ties to your interest in safe AI systems.
why_now.zh: 你关注具身AI与LLM，今日AI安全新闻直接关联你对安全AI系统的兴趣。

phrase.en: Trump warns of military action if diplomacy fails
phrase.zh: 特朗普警告外交失败将动武

phrase.en: oil price dives as US halts attacks
phrase.zh: 油价因美国停火而暴跌

gloss.en: Oil prices drop as US pauses attacks on Iran, but Trump warns of strong action if talks fail.
gloss.zh: 油价因美国暂停对伊打击而下跌，但特朗普警告谈判失败将采取强硬行动。

why_now.en: You follow geopolitics: today's mixed signals on Iran are a rare window into negotiation dynamics.
why_now.zh: 你关注地缘政治：今日伊朗问题的矛盾信号罕见地揭示了谈判动态。

phrase.zh: 伯纳姆将社会主义者纳入政府

phrase.en: Zelensky visit supports new UK PM
phrase.zh: 泽连斯基访英支持新首相

gloss.en: UK PM Burnham brings socialist faction into government while Zelensky visits, signaling a shift.
gloss.zh: 英国首相伯纳姆将社会主义派系纳入政府，同时泽连斯基到访，标志政治转向。

why_now.en: You follow political communication: this move reshapes the narrative of the new government.
why_now.zh: 你关注政治传播：此举重塑了新政府的叙事。
